programs.title: The Equalizer 2
programs.desc: Action crime thriller sequel. Denzel Washington returns as Robert McCall, who's out for revenge after ruthless killers murder an agency contact who he also considered a friend.

programs.title: The Hunt
programs.desc: Fighty, satirical horror that upset Donald Trump. Hilary Swank plays a rich lefty who likes hunting working class people to the death. But she didn't reckon on Betty Gilpin.

programs.title: Far North
programs.desc: Drama. Michelle Yeoh and Michelle Krusiec star as nomadic women in the Arctic tundra who, in rescuing a man (Sean Bean), instigate a deadly eternal triangle. Violent scenes.

programs.title: The True Story of Jesse James
programs.desc: Robert Wagner stars as the infamous outlaw in Nicholas Ray's western, which follows the last 18 years of the robber's life.

programs.title: It Should Happen to You
programs.desc: Judy Holliday stars in this comedy as a smalltown girl who comes to New York and rents a billboard to publicise her name - and soon she's a TV star. With Jack Lemmon.

programs.title: The Incredible Shrinking Man
programs.desc: Classic sci-fi horror about the perils of radiation. A normal-sized fella gets a lot, lot smaller when he breathes in a mysterious mist. Definitely not one for arachnophobes.

programs.title: The Kid Who Would Be King
programs.desc: Fantasy adventure. A 12-year-old from modern-day suburbia finds King Arthur's sword Excalibur and must save the country from a sinister sorceress. With Patrick Stewart.

programs.title: Ad Astra
programs.desc: Visually stunning sci-fi starring Brad Pitt as a famously cool astronaut sent to the edges of the solar system to save Earth from deadly power surges. With Tommy Lee Jones.
